title: Reverse trace inequality for powers greater than one
statement:
Let $A,B\geq 0$. Let $f$ be a nonnegative and nondecreasing function on an interval $\mathcal{J}$ such that $\operatorname{spec}(A)\subseteq\mathcal{J}$. **Reverse trace inequality.** One has

$$
\operatorname{Tr}\left[ f(A) A^s B^s \right] \geq \operatorname{Tr}\left[ f(A) \left(A^{1/2} B A^{1/2} \right)^s \right], \quad \forall\,s\geq 1.
$$

This conjectures the reverse of the proved trace inequality for $s\in[0,1]$. The authors note that operator convexity of $x\mapsto x^s$ may establish it for $s\in[1,2]$ under a suitable relaxation of an auxiliary theorem's hypotheses; the full range $s\geq 1$ remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05242

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2025).
source_name: Po-Chieh Liu and Hao-Chung Cheng, “On Araki-Type Trace Inequalities”, arXiv:2507.05242 (2025).
